correctness.rationale: Conditional Poisson thinning yields the exact four-state objective. The two-survivor tail has derivative F'(z)=z exp(-z); its even paired sum has at most one strict interior minimum because t/tanh(t) rises strictly. Hence only center or endpoints maximize. Their exact value difference has sign H(B)=beta B coth(beta B/2)-1-alpha B; H' < -ell <0 and the limiting signs plus explicit bounds prove the one unique budget root, exact optimizer sets and degeneracies. A self-contained finite checker performs 44,948 supplementary tests; no infinity conclusion is inferred from those samples.

originality.rationale: Materially inspected primary work on stochastic temporal invasion and ecological release strategies uses at-least-one independently successful lineages, spatially separate sites, or multigeneration stochastic population objectives. None of the inspected statements implies the present pooled two-survivor all-budget threshold. Indexed published-record searches and prior claim comparisons find no same theorem. This is a best-knowledge, qualified originality assessment, not verified historical priority; the Grevstad primary full text was inaccessible.
residual_risks: The Grevstad 1999 full article, which is especially plausible biological precedent, was unavailable despite bounded lawful retrieval attempts; the abstract alone cannot exclude exact coverage.

No independent validation or historical priority certification is represented.

value.rationale: A pooled two-founder demographic quorum and stochastic environmental timing create opposing risk-spreading and concentration incentives. The complete optimal-allocation classification, unique parameter-dependent budget root, exact triple tie, invariance to temporal environmental correlation and contrast with the one-founder objective give a motivated structural benchmark for introductions, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It intentionally makes no claim of actual ecological establishment or management applicability.
